rules.name: rrr-price-impact-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT c.security_id, CAST(b.settle_price AS numeric(30, 10)) AS migration_price, CAST(c.settle_price AS numeric(30, 10)) AS current_price, CAST(c.settle_price - b.settle_price AS numeric(30, 10)) AS price_difference, CASE WHEN b.settle_price = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST((c.settle_price - b.settle_price) / abs(b.settle_price) AS numeric(30, 8)) END AS relative_difference, c.created_by AS current_writer, c.created_timestamp AS current_written FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table c JOIN opera_backup_04_10.security_settlement_value_table b ON b.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND b.business_unit = c.business_unit AND b.security_id = c.security_id AND b.value_date = c.value_date WHERE c.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND abs(c.settle_price - b.settle_price) > 0.000001 ORDER BY abs(c.settle_price - b.settle_price) DESC LIMIT 2000

SELECT c.underlying_id, CAST(b.risk_free_rate AS numeric(30, 8)) AS migration_rate, CAST(c.risk_free_rate AS numeric(30, 8)) AS current_rate, CAST(b.settle_value AS numeric(30, 8)) AS migration_value, CAST(c.settle_value AS numeric(30, 8)) AS current_value, c.created_by AS current_writer, c.created_timestamp AS current_written, c.updated_by, c.updated_timestamp FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table c JOIN opera_backup_04_10.underlying_settle_value_table b ON b.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND b.underlying_id = c.underlying_id AND b.value_date = c.value_date WHERE c.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND (abs(coalesce(c.risk_free_rate, 0) - coalesce(b.risk_free_rate, 0)) > 0.0000001 OR abs(coalesce(c.settle_value, 0) - coalesce(b.settle_value, 0)) > 0.0000001) ORDER BY c.underlying_id LIMIT 200

SELECT upper(split_part(k.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client_code, COUNT(*) AS n_positions, COUNT(DISTINCT t.security_id) AS n_securities, ROUND(SUM((c.settle_price - b.settle_price) * k.active_lots * k.mult_factor * k.nc_factor * k.fx_nc_factor * -1)::numeric, 2) AS estimated_effect_usd FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table k JOIN opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table t ON t.tenant_id = k.tenant_id AND t.business_unit = k.business_unit AND t.trade_id = k.trade_id AND t.is_latest_version = 1 JOIN opera.security_settlement_value_table c ON c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND c.business_unit = t.business_unit AND c.security_id = t.security_id AND c.value_date = k.value_date JOIN opera_backup_04_10.security_settlement_value_table b ON b.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND b.business_unit = c.business_unit AND b.security_id = c.security_id AND b.value_date = c.value_date WHERE k.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND k.business_unit = :bu AND k.value_date = :valueDate AND (k.derivative_type LIKE '%call' OR k.derivative_type LIKE '%put') AND abs(c.settle_price - b.settle_price) > 0.000001 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY abs(SUM((c.settle_price - b.settle_price) * k.active_lots * k.mult_factor * k.nc_factor * k.fx_nc_factor * -1)) DESC LIMIT 60
